push.title: L 1-6 vs La Tuna | You: 7.2
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.2. A little below the line for a midfielder. We'll get you back above it.

THE GOOD
+ Stayed on and finished the match after PhogsToffees and BellyTb1 walked off. That's growth you can count.
+ 21 of the team's 21 passes attempted: the team ran through you. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ 2 tackles won: +0.5. Do that again.

THE BAD
- 67% passing (14 of 21, down from your usual 74%). Tiny tweak: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back. Bread and butter.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Quick fix: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
- 0.8 below usual. No panic, just practice.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 2. Note to self, from me to you.
- We shipped 6 goals to La Tuna and lost by 5. We dug that hole together; we'll climb out together.

Teach your feet: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Listen here, buddskees: Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

Go easy on yourself tonight. Go hard at it tomorrow. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-6 vs La Tuna | You: rage quit
push.body:
Alright, PhogsToffees. EA marked this one a rage quit, and I'm not gonna pretend I didn't see it.

THE BAD
- We shipped 6 goals to La Tuna and lost by 5. That's where we are. It's not where we're staying.
- Their humans averaged 9.0 to our 7.2; we were second best man for man. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.
- Your 3rd straight loss. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.
- Focus beats frenzy. Pick one.

THE UGLY
! Rage quit: you left before your stats even counted, before the final whistle, and the team played a player short. That's your 2nd walk-off for us. Losing is part of the game. Leaving isn't. Stick it out, even when it's ugly, because that's when your teammates need you most.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: Biscuits fix most things. Practice fixes the rest.

Rome wasn't built in a day, but they were laying bricks every hour. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
BellyTb1, I'm not grading football tonight. I'm talking about leaving your teammates.

THE BAD

- Their humans averaged 9.0 to our 7.2; we were second best man for man. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- Your 3rd straight loss. We win together and we wear this together.
- Take one lesson to the next game.

THE UGLY
! Rage quit: you left before your stats even counted, before the final whistle, and the team played a player short. That's your 4th walk-off for us. Walking off leaves your teammates playing short-handed, and that's the one thing I can't coach around. Frustration's allowed; quitting on each other isn't.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Nobody remembers the miss. Everybody remembers the response.

Pick one thing from that list and own it next match. Just one. - Coach Lasso
